summary: A shop selling downloadable products such as templates, themes, UI kits, presets, fonts, e-books or courses: a shelf with live or real previews, licence tiers, a product page with preview and changelog, and a checkout that ends in a download and licence key.

pages.purpose: Show the product working, let visitors browse the shelf by type, explain what is in the file and which licence to buy, and answer pre-download questions.

sections.purpose: Headline, one-line pitch and the best seller shown working (a live or real preview), with figures such as number of products, buyers and update count.
alternatives: video-player: a screen recording shows the product better than a live preview
stats-band: figures as their own band
fields: Figures: products, buyers, updates shipped (real numbers)
sections.notes: A preview of the real product beats a screenshot: render it at a simulated device width inside its own theme scope. Count-up figures must respect reduced motion.

sections.purpose: All products as cards whose thumbnail is the product itself, with a filter by type and price/licence from.
alternatives: entity-card: cards with badges (new, updated) and rating
fields: Products: name, type, short description, price from, thumbnail or preview
sections.notes: Describe what each thumbnail shows in text for people who cannot see it. New cards rise in after filtering (reduced motion: instant).

sections.purpose: What every purchase contains: file formats, components/pages, documentation, compatibility, updates.
fields: What is included (pages, components, assets, documentation)

sections.purpose: Licence tiers compared side by side (personal / team / commercial or extended): seats, projects, client work, resale, updates.
alternatives: pricing-table: two or three simple tiers without many rows
fields: What each tier allows: seats, projects, client work, products for sale
Update and support duration per tier
Buyer quotes with role and source

sections.purpose: Before-you-download questions: refunds on digital goods, licence transfer, updates, tax invoices, file access.
fields: How downloads and updates are delivered

sections.purpose: Sign-up for new releases and updates.
alternatives: email-capture: a compact signup inside another section or a sidebar
fields: What is sent and how often

pages.purpose: Try before buying: interactive preview, licence picker, details of the file and the changelog.

sections.purpose: The product previewed with switches that matter for it (page, device width, light/dark, colour, font), next to the licence picker and buy button.
alternatives: video-player: video walkthrough for courses or plugins
gallery: still screenshots when a live preview is impossible
sections.notes: Licence choice is a radio group. Inside a live preview there are no headings or landmarks; it is a picture made of live parts, with a text description.

sections.purpose: Facts about the file: version, formats, size, requirements, last update, licence summary.
Version history so buyers see the product is maintained.

pages.purpose: Pay for one product and licence: optional lifetime-updates add-on, discount code, tax by country, then a download state with the licence key.

sections.purpose: Summary of product and licence, add-ons, discount code, billing country with tax, email for delivery, payment.
fields: Tax rules by country (VAT/sales tax, reverse charge for businesses)
sections.notes: No shipping address for digital goods. Ask for the billing country before showing the total; show tax as its own line.

pages.purpose: Deliver the purchase: download button, licence key, invoice, how updates arrive.

sections.purpose: Order number, download links, licence key with copy, invoice and next steps.
fields: How long download links stay valid
sections.notes: Copy feedback for the licence key uses role=status.

content: Product list: name, type, description, version, formats, requirements
Preview for each product (live build, screenshots or walkthrough video)
Licence tiers with prices and exactly what each allows
What every download contains and documentation
Refund policy for digital goods and the right-of-withdrawal waiver text
Tax handling by country and the payment provider
Download delivery method and licence key system
Real buyer quotes and real figures

styles.name: precise tool
styles.why: Grotesk type, a fresh green accent, glass panels and snappy motion feel like a tool, not a show reel — suits template and UI kit sellers.

styles.name: dark studio
styles.why: Lets bright previews pop; suits presets, plugins and developer products.

styles.name: quiet editorial
styles.why: For e-books, fonts and writing-led products.

pitfalls: Licence terms vague ('commercial use allowed') instead of concrete rows: seats, projects, client work, resale.
Right of withdrawal not handled: consumers must explicitly agree that the download starts immediately and waives withdrawal.
Total changes at the last step because tax by country is added late; ask the billing country early.
Previews that are only images with no text description, or live previews full of headings and landmarks that confuse screen readers.
Download links that expire without a way to get them again.
Changelog missing or stale, which makes buyers doubt the product is maintained.
Live previews that load a whole app on the home page and slow it down; freeze thumbnails, run the live one only on demand.
